help.title: OLA Help
items: Drag OLA’s body to move OLA around the screen.
Press the chest core to switch between Sleep and Wake.
Select a card or panel to hear an explanation of that feature.
After auto sleep, press the chest core to wake OLA.
OLA responds with expressions and gentle guidance motions.
Reset the position to return OLA to the default resting place.
OLA Station keeps OLA in a safe resting position.
